record_note: Wired by hand on 2026-09-19 (commit 61dac7f, 'process: plunk in the gate (ruff + pytest + fresh-venv run + version invariant)'), before the kit existed as a git repo — so `revision` is the kit's FIRST PUBLISHED commit, not the exact copy point; do not read it as the tree this repo was copied from. The hooks are byte-identical to the kit's; the gate script's one divergence is a kit fix that landed after the copy, not a local decision (see its adapted_why). The kit's C++ and Deno artifacts (tools/ci.sh, .ci.env.example, templates/deno/gate.sh, .gitignore) never applied to this Python repo and are not listed; ruff.toml, mypy.ini, pytest.ini and .gitignore here are this repo's own files, not kit copies. Rule that keeps this file true: any commit that edits a copied artifact must update that artifact's repo_sha256 in the same commit.

files.adapted_why: Not a local decision, and nothing in it was written for docsum: the copy is byte-identical to the kit's python gate as it stood BEFORE card t_561f6857 (verified 2026-09-20 by reverse-applying that card's own recorded patch to the kit file — 25606 bytes, same sha256), so the only divergence from the current kit is that later tool_env/py_env fix for a src-layout unpackaged repo. That fix is inert here (docsum keeps its package at the repo root, which `python -m` already reaches), which is why the copy was left alone rather than synced mid-record; a sync should bring it level with the kit and then set adapted to false.

Seeded from the kit's rule block on 2026-09-19 and then grown to 278 lines of this repo's own history (the kit's file is 159): per-repo incident log, so a sync must never overwrite it with the kit's entries.
